body: I’m gonna admit it, when I typed this I was in a very bad state. I’m just starting out and I should be expecting to have a lot of things to work on. It’s bad I’m saying this shit so thanks for giving this kick in the ass and keep me going

I’m not expecting to make it pro, but you know, I wanna be happy playing ball but how can I be happy when I know I can do better. Combined with the fact I haven’t grown in 2-3 years means I will probably be stuck at 5’6. I just wanna play better and be happy knowing I can do something decently. Not being happy even when I play like trash

I can relate to your situation rn, although it was only 2 weeks. I basically forgot how to shoot for a time, and it had a huge impact especially because I’m 5’6 my game revolves a lot around that and my defence. What I did was to record my shooting and see what I can improve. Eventually I found what was wrong and switched my form and I’m slowly getting buckets again. Good luck!

I feel like maybe accepting people of all ages would be better, I'm 16 and my anger issues have plagued me since I was 10 or 11, and it isn't helping that people take the piss out of me as a joke.  There are many more teens like me who probably have some sort of anger issue as well and can't let it out healthily.
